entries.name: Grand Convergence
entries.subject: Grand Convergence. Fire, Ice and Lightning converge on the target after {delay} s: {damage_min}-{damage_max} damage within {radius} m, {per_charge}% more per Arcane Charge (all charge is spent once).

entries.name: Prismatic Tempest
entries.subject: Prismatic Tempest. A tempest ({radius} m) at the target for {duration} s. Every {interval} s it strikes with Fire, then Water, then Lightning: {damage_min}-{damage_max} damage. Water leaves enemies Wet, so the next Lightning pulse conducts (+25%) and Fire is dampened. One enemy is struck at most {hit_cap} times.

entries.name: Spellweave
entries.subject: Spellweave. Weave the next damaging spell you pay Mana for within {duration} s: it repeats once at {weave_pct}% strength. The repeat costs nothing, refunds nothing and cannot repeat or echo again.

entries.name: Aether Lance
entries.subject: Aether Lance. An aimed lance of Aether that pierces every enemy in line: {damage_min}-{damage_max} damage, 60% Light and 40% Dark.

entries.name: Mana Ward
entries.subject: Mana Ward. Pour Mana into a ward: it absorbs {per_mana} damage for each point of Mana paid, at most {cap}% of your Maximum HP, for {duration} s. The ward never drains more Mana after it forms.

entries.name: Runic Circle
entries.subject: Runic Circle. Draw a runic circle ({radius} m) at your feet for {duration} s. While you stand in it, spells you pay Mana for deal {spell_pct}% more damage. One circle at a time; it never stacks with itself.

entries.name: Arcane Precision
entries.subject: Arcane Precision. +{0}% Critical Chance and +{1}% Critical Damage.

entries.name: Arcane Surge
entries.subject: Arcane Surge. Detonate all Arcane Charge: {damage_min}-{damage_max} damage (Light and Dark) +{per_charge}% per charge in {radius} m. Restores {mana_per_charge} Mana per charge.

entries.name: Arms Mastery
entries.subject: Arms Mastery. +{0}% increased weapon damage and +{1}% Critical Chance.

entries.name: Arrow Rain
entries.subject: Arrow Rain. Arrows fall on the target area for {duration} s: every {tick} s, {weapon_pct}% weapon damage to enemies within {radius} m.

entries.name: Aura of Cinders
entries.subject: Aura of Cinders. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m deal {fire}% increased Fire damage. Every second, enemies within {pulse_radius} m take {pulse_min}-{pulse_max} Fire damage. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Clarity
entries.subject: Aura of Clarity. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m regenerate Mana {mana}% faster. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Defiance
entries.subject: Aura of Defiance. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m gain {def}% increased Defense. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Fervor
entries.subject: Aura of Fervor. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m attack and cast {speed}% faster. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Mending
entries.subject: Aura of Mending. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m restore {heal_pct}% of their Maximum HP every second. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Might
entries.subject: Aura of Might. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m deal {dmg}% more damage. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Thorns
entries.subject: Aura of Thorns. Aura (toggle). Melee attackers of allies within {radius} m take {reflect}% of the damage they deal. Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Aura of Winter
entries.subject: Aura of Winter. Aura (toggle). Allies within {radius} m gain {ice_res}% Ice Resistance. Every second, enemies within {pulse_radius} m take {pulse_min}-{pulse_max} Ice damage and build Chill ({pulse_chill}). Reserves {reserve_pct}% of Maximum Mana while active. Only one aura at a time.

entries.name: Blade Mastery
entries.subject: Blade Mastery. Daggers, claws and knuckles deal +{0}% increased damage; +{3}% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Blade Sentinel
entries.subject: Blade Sentinel. Set a whirling blade trap (up to {max_count}) for {duration} s: every {interval} s it cuts enemies within {reach} m for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage with Bleeding.

entries.name: Blast Arrow
entries.subject: Blast Arrow. An arrow packed with black powder: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, half as Fire, exploding in {explode_radius} m. Ignites.

entries.name: Blast Trap
entries.subject: Blast Trap. Set a powder trap (shared limit with Snare Trap) that explodes when an enemy comes near: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage in {radius} m, 60% as Fire. Ignites.

entries.name: Hallowed Hammer
entries.subject: Hallowed Hammer. Hurl a hammer of light that spirals outward for {duration} s, striking every enemy it passes for {damage_min}-{damage_max} Light damage.

entries.name: Blink
entries.subject: Blink. Teleport up to {range} m toward the cursor, leaving an arcane burst that pushes nearby enemies away.

entries.name: Blizzard
entries.subject: Blizzard. Summon a storm of ice over the target for {duration} s: every {tick} s, {damage_min}-{damage_max} Ice damage to enemies within {radius} m and heavy Chill.

entries.name: Blood Eclipse
entries.subject: Blood Eclipse. Finisher. Spend all Combo in an eclipse of blood around you ({radius} m): {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, {pip_more}% more per pip, and {vs_bleeding_pct}% more to Bleeding enemies. You heal {heal_pct}% of the damage actually dealt, at most {heal_cap_pct}% of your Maximum HP per cast.

entries.name: Crimson Rend
entries.subject: Crimson Rend. A rending cut ({arc}°, {range} m): {weapon_pct}% weapon damage and heavy Bleeding ({bleed}). +{combo_gain} Combo.

entries.name: Sanguine Pact
entries.subject: Sanguine Pact. Pay {hp_cost}% of your current HP (never your last point of HP) to deal {dmg}% more damage for {duration} s. While the pact lasts each hit you land heals {heal_hit}% of your Maximum HP, at most {heal_sec}% a second.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.subject: Chain Lightning. A bolt that arcs between up to {chains} enemies for {damage_min}-{damage_max} Lightning damage each, losing 10% per jump.

entries.name: Cleave
entries.subject: Cleave. A wide, heavy sweep dealing {weapon_pct}% weapon damage to all enemies in a {arc}° arc and knocking them back.

entries.name: Crippling Star
entries.subject: Crippling Star. Builder. Hurl {count} throwing stars: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage each, Bleeding, Slowed and Dazzled. +{combo_gain} Combo.

entries.name: Crusader's Resolve
entries.subject: Crusader's Resolve. +{0}% Valor generation and +{1}% Physical Damage.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries.subject: Deadeye. Spend all Focus on one perfect shot: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage +{per_focus}% per Focus spent, piercing every enemy in its path. At {crit_focus}+ Focus it always crits.

entries.name: Deadly Aim
entries.subject: Deadly Aim. +{0}% Critical Damage.

entries.name: Death Blossom
entries.subject: Death Blossom. Finisher. Spend all Combo and whirl through everything within {range} m: {strikes} cuts of {weapon_pct}% weapon damage +{per_pip}% per pip, with Bleeding.

entries.name: Black Dominion
entries.subject: Black Dominion. Darken the ground at the target ({radius} m) for {duration} s. It strikes once on landing for {initial_pct}% weapon damage, {per_valor}% more per Valor (all Valor is spent once), then pulses every {interval} s for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, 70% as Dark.

entries.name: Dread Cleave
entries.subject: Dread Cleave. A wide sweep of {arc}° and {range} m: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, 40% of it as Dark, and every enemy struck is Weakened (20% less damage) for 3 s.

entries.name: Warbound Advance
entries.subject: Warbound Advance. Advance {dash} m and bring down a heavy blow around the end of the advance: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage. For {self_dur} s you gain +50% Knockback Resistance and 50% more Poise.

entries.name: Dread Mark
entries.subject: Dread Mark. Brand every enemy within {radius} m with dread: they flee in terror for {fear_dur} s and take {mark_pct}% more damage.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.subject: Evasion. +{0}% increased Evasion.

entries.name: Eviscerate
entries.subject: Eviscerate. Finisher. Spend all Combo on one brutal strike against a single enemy: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage +{per_pip}% per pip. The wound is Grievous (healing received -25%). Poised (full Combo): always a critical hit.

entries.name: Fan of Knives
entries.subject: Fan of Knives. Builder. Throw {count} knives in every direction, each {weapon_pct}% weapon damage with Bleeding. +{combo_gain} Combo.

entries.name: Firebolt
entries.subject: Firebolt. Hurl a bolt of fire for {damage_min}-{damage_max} Fire damage that always ignites. At 3+ Arcane Charge it splits into three.

entries.name: Flame Sentinel
entries.subject: Flame Sentinel. Raise a pillar of living flame for {duration} s that hurls a fire bolt at the nearest enemy every {interval} s ({damage_min}-{damage_max} Fire damage). Up to {max_count} at once.

entries.name: Fleet Foot
entries.subject: Fleet Foot. +{0}% increased Movement Speed.

entries.name: Fleet Step
entries.subject: Fleet Step. +{0}% Movement Speed and {1} s faster dodge recovery.

entries.name: Frost Arrow
entries.subject: Frost Arrow. An arrow of rime: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, 60% of it as Ice, with heavy Chill.

entries.name: Frost Mastery
entries.subject: Frost Mastery. +{0}% increased Ice damage and +{1}% Ice Penetration.

entries.name: Frost Nova
entries.subject: Frost Nova. Release a ring of frost: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Ice damage within {radius} m and heavy Chill buildup. Wet enemies freeze instantly.

entries.name: Frost Orb
entries.subject: Frost Orb. Launch a slow orb of frost that sheds whirling ice shards as it flies and bursts into a ring of shards: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Ice damage per shard and Chill.

entries.name: Gale Burst
entries.subject: Gale Burst. A piercing blast of wind: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Wind damage, huge knockback, destroys enemy projectiles in its path and fans Burning.

entries.name: Dawn Verdict
entries.subject: Dawn Verdict. A heavy radiant blow ({arc}°, {range} m): {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, half as Light, and {per_valor}% more damage per Valor spent (all Valor is spent once).

entries.name: Oath of Mercy
entries.subject: Oath of Mercy. Speak the oath: you and every ally within {radius} m lose one harmful ailment (the worst first) and gain a barrier of {barrier}% of your Maximum HP for {duration} s (at most a quarter of their own Maximum HP).

entries.name: Sanctified Ground
entries.subject: Sanctified Ground. Sanctify {radius} m of ground at the target for {duration} s. Every {interval} s enemies inside take {weapon_pct}% weapon damage as Light, and you and your allies inside recover {heal_pct}% of Maximum HP (each ally at most {heal_cap}% per cast).

entries.name: Ground Fissure
entries.subject: Ground Fissure. Split the earth in a {length} m line: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage as Earth. Heavily staggers and ignores part of armor.

entries.name: Heaven's Fist
entries.subject: Heaven's Fist. Call down a bolt of holy lightning on the target: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Lightning and Light damage in {radius} m, and {radial_bolts} holy bolts burst outward ({bolt_pct}% damage each).

entries.name: Hunter's Mark
entries.subject: Hunter's Mark. Mark every enemy within {radius} m of the target for {mark_dur} s: they take {mark_pct}% more damage and cannot hide.

entries.name: Inner Fire
entries.subject: Inner Fire; Arcane Arts. +{0}% increased Mana Regeneration. Paid spells have a 30% chance to refund {f0}% of their actual Mana cost. Echoes do not refund Mana.

entries.name: Iron Bulwark
entries.subject: Iron Bulwark. Brace behind your guard for {duration} s: +{block}% Block Chance and +{kb_res}% Knockback Resistance. Blocks during Bulwark grant double Valor.

entries.name: Iron Skin
entries.subject: Iron Skin. +{0}% increased Defense.

entries.name: Judgment
entries.subject: Judgment. Spend all Valor (min {valor_min}) on a radiant overhead strike: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage +{per_valor}% per Valor spent as Physical and Light in a line. Heals 5% of damage dealt and Demoralizes the foe.

entries.name: Keen Eye
entries.subject: Keen Eye. +{0}% Critical Chance and +{1} Accuracy.

entries.name: Leap Slam
entries.subject: Leap Slam. Leap to a location up to {range} m away and crash down for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage as Physical and Earth in a {radius} m radius, launching enemies.

entries.name: Lethality
entries.subject: Lethality. +{0}% Critical Damage.

entries.name: Light Feet
entries.subject: Light Feet. +{0}% increased Evasion and {1} s faster dodge recovery.

entries.name: Mana Shield
entries.subject: Mana Shield. {f0}% of damage taken drains Mana instead (1.5 Mana per point).

entries.name: Meteor Strike
entries.subject: Meteor Strike. Call a meteor onto the target area after {delay} s: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Fire and Earth damage in {radius} m, burning ground, massive impact.

entries.name: Multishot
entries.subject: Multishot. Loose a fan of {count} arrows, each dealing {weapon_pct}% weapon damage.

entries.name: Gloom Veil
entries.subject: Gloom Veil. Wrap yourself in gloom: enemies within {radius} m lose you, and you gain Stealth and {evasion}% more Evasion for {duration} s. Attacking ends both.

entries.name: Marked Execution
entries.subject: Marked Execution. Finisher. Spend all Combo on one enemy: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, {pip_more}% more per pip, and {vs_marked_pct}% more against a Marked or Quarry-marked enemy. Poised: always a critical hit.

entries.name: Umbral Lunge
entries.subject: Umbral Lunge. Lunge {dash} m through the shadows and strike: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, 30% as Dark. A cast that lands adds {combo_gain} Combo once, however many enemies it strikes.

entries.name: Oathbound Resilience
entries.subject: Oathbound Resilience; Unfallen. +{0}% to all elemental Resistances. Bramwold's heart never stopped: you and every Tempo near him are warded for half of maximum HP, and every monster within 12 m turns on him.

entries.name: Opportunist
entries.subject: Opportunist. Hits from behind deal {f0}% more damage.

entries.name: Patient Hunter
entries.subject: Patient Hunter. +{0}% Focus gain. You are Steady from 50 Focus instead of 60.

entries.name: Piercing Arrows
entries.subject: Piercing Arrows. Your arrows have a {f0}% chance to pierce one more enemy; +{0}% projectile damage.

entries.name: Power Shot
entries.subject: Power Shot. A heavy, drawn arrow for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage that pierces {pierce} enemy and hurls targets back.

entries.name: Afterimage Flurry
entries.subject: Afterimage Flurry. Leave {strikes} afterimages that strike from where you stand over {span} s: each hits the nearest enemy within {reach} m for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage. Afterimage hits cannot trigger Double Attack or other repeat attacks.

entries.name: Phantom Crossing
entries.subject: Phantom Crossing. Cross to the far side of the enemy nearest your aim (up to {range} m; walls stop you) and strike for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage. For {self_dur} s afterwards you have 60% more Evasion. +{combo_gain} Combo.

entries.name: Reaper's Arc
entries.subject: Reaper's Arc. Finisher. Spend all Combo on a {arc}° reaping arc ({range} m): {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, {pip_more}% more per pip, to the nearest enemy and {secondary_pct}% of that to the others.

entries.name: Pyre Mastery
entries.subject: Pyre Mastery. +{0}% increased Fire damage and +{1}% Fire Penetration.

entries.name: Quickstep
entries.subject: Quickstep. Move {speed}% faster and attack {atk}% faster for {duration} s. Your dodge is ready at once.

entries.name: Radiant Ward
entries.subject: Radiant Ward. Wrap yourself in light: a ward absorbing {absorb}% of Maximum HP for {duration} s and healing {heal}% of Maximum HP.

entries.name: Counter-attack
entries.subject: Counter-attack. Blocking has a {f0}% chance to counterattack for 120% weapon damage. 2 s cooldown. Cannot counter another passive hit.

entries.name: Bastion Rush
entries.subject: Bastion Rush. Charge {dash} m behind your shield and slam everything at the end of the charge: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, a heavy knockback, and a stagger. The charge stops at walls. Requires a shield.

entries.name: Bulwark Standard
entries.subject: Bulwark Standard. Plant a standard at the target for {duration} s. You and every ally within {radius} m gain +{block}% Block Chance, +{kb}% Knockback Resistance and +{poise_inc}% Poise. No shield needed. One standard at a time; several Royal Guards' standards do not stack.

entries.name: Sovereign's Challenge
entries.subject: Sovereign's Challenge. Challenge every enemy within {radius} m: for {taunt} s they attack you instead of your allies, and you take {dr}% less damage for {duration} s. Bosses ignore the challenge but you keep the protection.

entries.name: Ruthless
entries.subject: Ruthless. Enemies below 35% HP take {f0}% more damage from you.

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.subject: Second Wind; Enduring Recovery. Dropping below 35% HP restores {f0}% of Maximum HP over 4 s (once every 45 s). Each distinct active debuff restores an extra {f0}% of Maximum HP per second. Healing reductions still apply.

entries.name: Shadow Curse
entries.subject: Shadow Curse. Curse all enemies in {radius} m: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Dark damage (drains life), and they take 15% more damage for {duration} s.

entries.name: Shadow Discipline
entries.subject: Shadow Discipline. Combo lingers {f0} s longer. At rank 5: +1 maximum Combo.

entries.name: Shadow Step
entries.subject: Shadow Step. Step through the shadows to appear behind the enemy nearest your aim (up to {range} m) and strike for {weapon_pct}% weapon damage. +{combo_gain} Combo.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries.subject: Shield Bash. Charge {dash} m and slam your shield into the first enemy: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage, stun and a violent knockback. Sunders the target (25% less Defense). Without a shield, uses the pommel for half the stun.

entries.name: Shield Mastery
entries.subject: Shield Mastery. +{0}% Block Chance and +{1}% Block Strength.

entries.name: Smoke Veil
entries.subject: Smoke Veil. Burst into smoke: enemies within {radius} m lose you and you gain Stealth for {duration} s. Your next hit from Stealth deals 50% more damage and always crits.

entries.name: Snare Trap
entries.subject: Snare Trap. Set a trap (up to {max_traps}) that springs when an enemy steps near: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage in {radius} m and Webbed for {web_dur} s.

entries.name: Spell Echo
entries.subject: Spell Echo. Damaging spells have a {f0}% chance to cast again at half strength.

entries.name: Astral Pierce
entries.subject: Astral Pierce. A narrow starlit shot that pierces every enemy in line: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage (40% Light), {per_focus}% more per Focus spent (all Focus is spent once). Enemies after the first take {falloff_pct}%.

entries.name: Comet Step
entries.subject: Comet Step. Vault {range} m away from your aim (you cannot be hit while in the air). For {window} s your next arrow, bolt or javelin deals {bonus}% more damage.

entries.name: Constellation Rain
entries.subject: Constellation Rain. {impacts} starlit shots fall over {duration} s in a {radius} m area at a visible point: each deals {weapon_pct}% weapon damage (30% Light) within {impact_radius} m. One enemy is struck at most {hit_cap} times.

entries.name: Stone Spear
entries.subject: Stone Spear. Launch a jagged spear of stone: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Earth damage, massive stagger; pins enemies against walls for extra impact.

entries.name: Storm Javelin
entries.subject: Storm Javelin. Hurl a conjured javelin of lightning: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage (70% Lightning) that arcs to {chains} more enemies, losing 10% per jump.

entries.name: Storm Mastery
entries.subject: Storm Mastery. +{0}% increased Lightning damage and +{1}% Lightning Penetration.

entries.name: Survivalist
entries.subject: Survivalist. +{0}% Maximum HP and +{1}% Status Resistance.

entries.name: Disengage
entries.subject: Disengage. Vaults away from a monster that got too close, leaving a snare that slows it.

entries.name: Rime Arrow
entries.subject: Rime Arrow. An arrow of grave-cold. It chills everything it passes through; chill that builds up freezes.

entries.name: Mending Arrow
entries.subject: Mending Arrow. Looses an arrow of pale light at an ally: heals 18% of their maximum HP and more over 4 s. Never misses a friend.

entries.name: Piercing Arrow
entries.subject: Piercing Arrow. A spirit-charged arrow that passes through up to four monsters in a line.

entries.name: Thornsnare
entries.subject: Thornsnare. Throws a snare of spirit-thorns under a pack: every monster in it is slowed and cut for 5 s.

entries.name: Rain of Ghost Arrows
entries.subject: Rain of Ghost Arrows. Arrows fall on an area three times. Best against packs and slow giants.

entries.name: Unbroken Bastion
entries.subject: Unbroken Bastion. Hollan's last stand at the Aubren gate: wards you and every Tempo near him (30% of maximum HP) and draws every monster within 8 m onto himself.

entries.name: Cinderfall
entries.subject: Cinderfall. The volley that brought down a Tyrant: five waves of burning arrows over a wide area.

entries.name: Radiant Dawn
entries.subject: Radiant Dawn. A burst of lantern-light around Maudra. The dead and the cursed burn in it.

entries.name: Nightfall
entries.subject: Nightfall. Vessik steps out of the dark behind a monster and curses it. Deals 2.5 times the damage below 40% health, and if it kills, he is ready to strike again at once.

entries.name: Lantern of Sanctuary
entries.subject: Lantern of Sanctuary. Maudra lifts her lantern: you and every ally within 10 m are healed 30% of maximum HP, more over 4 s, and cured of poison, bleeding and burning.

entries.name: Stormbreak
entries.subject: Stormbreak. Kavira rides the lightning into a monster and it arcs on through five more, shocking every one.

entries.name: Aether Bolt
entries.subject: Aether Bolt. A bolt of pale Aether that purges a monster's healing and wards.

entries.name: Arc of Storms
entries.subject: Arc of Storms. Lightning that leaps from monster to monster, up to five of them, shocking each one.

entries.name: Grave-Frost Nova
entries.subject: Grave-Frost Nova. A burst of grave-cold around the Mystic: every monster near it is chilled, and chill that builds up freezes.

entries.name: Soul Ward
entries.subject: Soul Ward. Wraps you in a barrier that absorbs damage equal to 18% of your maximum HP for 8 s.

entries.name: Grave Challenge
entries.subject: Grave Challenge. Bellows at the monsters around it. They turn on the Tempo instead of you, and it takes 20% less damage for 5 s.

entries.name: Rending Charge
entries.subject: Rending Charge. Charges a distant monster, cutting through everything in the way and staggering it.

entries.name: Vengeful Cleave
entries.subject: Vengeful Cleave. A wide, furious sweep that hits every monster in front of it.

entries.name: Soul Mend
entries.subject: Soul Mend. Pours some of its own spirit into an ally: heals 20% of their maximum HP at once and more over 4 s.

entries.name: Rally the Fallen
entries.subject: Rally the Fallen. A dead soldier's battle cry: you and your Tempos deal 20% more damage for 8 s.

entries.name: Spectral Whirlwind
entries.subject: Spectral Whirlwind. Spins with its blade out and cuts every monster around it.

entries.name: Fan of Knives
entries.subject: Fan of Knives. Throws a ring of ghost-knives. Every monster around it is cut and bleeds.

entries.name: Final Cut
entries.subject: Final Cut. A killing stroke: 2.5 times the damage against a monster below 35% health.

entries.name: Stolen Remedy
entries.subject: Stolen Remedy. Tosses an ally a draught lifted from someone who did not need it: heals 15%, more over 4 s, and cures poison and bleeding.

entries.name: Shadowstep
entries.subject: Shadowstep. Steps through shadow behind a monster and drives both blades into its back.

entries.name: Smoke Bomb
entries.subject: Smoke Bomb. Vanishes in black smoke: nearby monsters are slowed and weakened, and the Tempo slips away unseen.

entries.name: Venom Blades
entries.subject: Venom Blades. A flurry of three poisoned cuts; for 8 s every strike poisons.

entries.name: Guardian's Aegis
entries.subject: Guardian's Aegis. Raises a ghostly shield over you that absorbs damage equal to 22% of your maximum HP for 8 s.

entries.name: Shield Crush
entries.subject: Shield Crush. Drives its shield into a monster: heavy stagger, and its armor starts to crack.

entries.name: Iron Oath
entries.subject: Iron Oath. Swears to hold. Every monster within 9 m turns on the Warden, which takes 20% less damage for 6 s.

entries.name: Earthshaker
entries.subject: Earthshaker. Slams the ground: every monster within 4 m is staggered and has its armor broken.

entries.name: Tidal Wave
entries.subject: Tidal Wave. A crashing wave in a {length} m line: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Water damage, soaks enemies (Wet) and sweeps them away.

entries.name: Tide & Stone Mastery
entries.subject: Tide & Stone Mastery. +{0}% increased Water, Earth and Wind damage.

entries.name: Toughness
entries.subject: Toughness; Steadfast. +{0}% Maximum HP and +{1} Poise. +{0}% Knockback Resistance and +{1}% Block Chance.

entries.name: Quarry Mark
entries.subject: Quarry Mark. Mark the visible enemy nearest your aim (within {range} m) as your quarry for {duration} s: your own arrows, bolts and javelins deal {mark_pct}% more damage to it. Other players' hits are unaffected.

entries.name: Snareline
entries.subject: Snareline. Lay {count} snares in a line toward your aim. The first time each enemy steps on one it takes {weapon_pct}% weapon damage and is rooted for {root} s (bosses and root-immune enemies are slowed instead). Snares last {duration} s.

entries.name: Trail Volley
entries.subject: Trail Volley. Loose a fan of {count} shots, each {weapon_pct}% weapon damage. Each enemy can be struck by only one shot of the fan.

entries.name: Trapmaster
entries.subject: Trapmaster. +{0}% trap damage. At rank 5 you may keep one more trap.

entries.name: Twin Fang
entries.subject: Twin Fang. Builder. Two quick cuts, each {weapon_pct}% weapon damage. +{combo_gain} Combo (a critical hit adds one more).

entries.name: Vault
entries.subject: Vault. Vault {range} m away from where you aim (untouchable in the air), scattering caltrops that deal {weapon_pct}% weapon damage per half-second and slow for {duration} s.

entries.name: Venom Strike
entries.subject: Venom Strike. Builder. A poisoned thrust: {weapon_pct}% weapon damage and heavy Poison ({poison_buildup}). +{combo_gain} Combo.

entries.name: Venomcraft
entries.subject: Venomcraft. +{0}% Damage over Time (Bleeding, Poison) and +{1}% Status Chance.

entries.name: Event Horizon
entries.subject: Event Horizon. Open a gravity well ({radius} m) at the target for {duration} s. Every {interval} s it pulls enemies toward its center (walls stop the pull; Knockback Resistance shortens it; bosses are not pulled) and deals {damage_min}-{damage_max} Dark damage.

entries.name: Null Lance
entries.subject: Null Lance. A lance of nothing that pierces every enemy in line: {damage_min}-{damage_max} Dark damage that ignores {pen_pct}% more of their armor and Dark Resistance (penetration limits still apply).

entries.subject: Shocked; Static. Takes increased damage from all sources (15%, 25% while Wet). Storm Herald bolts charge you. Three charges and you are Stunned.

entries.name: Silenced
entries.subject: Silenced; Curse of Stillness. Cannot cast spells. Weapon skills still work. Standing in a Curse of Stillness: no spell can be cast. Weapon skills still work. Step out of the sigil.

entries.name: Paralyzing Attack
entries.subject: Paralyzing Attack; Slowed. Movement slowed by 30-85% for a brief moment. 30% slower movement.

entries.name: Spirit Ward
entries.subject: Spirit Ward; Prismatic Shelter; Warden's Refuge. Warded against the strange: +15% to every Resistance and +30% Status Resistance. Higher Resistances (caps still apply).

entries.name: Staggered
entries.subject: Staggered; Exposed. Poise broken; unable to act for at most 0.75 s, followed by 0.6 s protection from another stagger. Takes 30% more damage while recovering from a stagger.

entries.name: Steady
entries.subject: Steady; Comet Step; Star Chart. Focus 60+: +10% Critical Chance. Your next arrow, bolt or javelin deals more damage.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.subject: Stealth; Ethereal; Gloom Veil. Hidden in shadow: enemies lose you. Your next attack deals 50% more damage, always crits and ends the Stealth. Immune to physical damage; takes 50% more elemental damage.

entries.name: Stunned
entries.subject: Stunned; Petrified; Dazed. Cannot act. Turned to stone by a basilisk's gaze: cannot act. Look away from a gazing basilisk.

entries.name: Sundered
entries.subject: Sundered. Guard shattered: 25% less Defense and 10% more damage taken.

entries.name: Titan's Might
entries.subject: Titan's Might. Borrowed strength: 15% more Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Wisdom, Spirit and Dexterity.

entries.name: War Cry
entries.subject: War Cry. Increased Defense and Valor generation.

entries.name: Vigor
entries.subject: Vigor. Bursting with life: 15% more Maximum HP and 25% more healing and regeneration received.

entries.name: Weakened
entries.subject: Weakened. Deals 20% less damage.

entries.name: Webbed
entries.subject: Webbed; Rooted. Stuck in sticky webbing: 80% slower and cannot dodge. Held fast by snares or roots: cannot move.

entries.name: Wet
entries.subject: Wet. Lightning hits harder and Shocks twice as fast, Freeze builds twice as fast, Fire is dampened. Extinguishes Burning.

entries.name: Windstep
entries.subject: Windstep; Phantom Crossing; Untouchable Rhythm. Light on the feet: 40% more Evasion, 15% more Movement Speed and a shorter dodge cooldown. 60% more Evasion for a moment.

entries.name: Windswept
entries.subject: Windswept. 15% slower and 30% lower Knockback Resistance. Built up by Wind damage.

entries.name: Dark
entries.subject: Dark. Curse amplifies all damage taken; Dark hits drain life and rend Purged targets.

entries.name: Earth
entries.subject: Earth. Armor Break (-40% Defense) and heavy stagger. Crushes armored targets harder.

entries.name: Fire
entries.subject: Fire. Burning: damage over time. Offensive pressure. Spreads with Wind.

entries.name: Ice
entries.subject: Ice. Chill slows; Chill buildup becomes Freeze. Wet targets freeze twice as fast.

entries.name: Light
entries.subject: Light. Radiant. Purges enemy regeneration and buffs; purifies Curses for a burst.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.subject: Lightning. Shock: target takes more damage. High burst, can chain. Wet targets are shocked harder.

entries.name: Physical
entries.subject: Physical. Raw force. Mitigated by Defense; builds Stagger.

entries.name: Water
entries.subject: Water. Wet: conducts Lightning, speeds Freeze, extinguishes Burning.

entries.name: Wind
entries.subject: Wind. Windswept: knockback x1.5 and slowed. Fans Burning onto nearby foes.

entries.name: Knight
entries.subject: Knight. A durable melee fighter who builds Valor through attacks and blocks. Learn knockback resistance, counterattacks, damage return and extra regeneration for each debuff. Auras support nearby allies.

entries.name: Mage
entries.subject: Mage. A ranged spellcaster who combines elemental damage with gravity pulls, stuns and curses. Meteor Strike deals heavy area damage; Mana Siphon and Arcane Arts help manage expensive spells.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.subject: Hunter. A ranged fighter using bows, crossbows, javelins and traps. Learn Knee Shot to stun enemies and Split Shot to fire additional arrows. Builds Focus at a distance and spends it on stronger shots.

entries.name: Shadowblade
entries.subject: Shadowblade. A fast melee fighter who builds Combo for finishers. Learn Double Attack, brief paralyzing slows, lifesteal on every second attack and Bloodcurse to reduce enemy healing.

entries.name: Archer
entries.subject: Archer. Keeps its distance and its aim. Pierces lines of foes, rains arrows on crowds and falls back when anything gets too close.

entries.name: Mystic
entries.subject: Mystic. Weaves loose Aether into bolts and wards. Keeps to the back, shields you from the worst blows and mends what gets through.

entries.name: Swordsman
entries.subject: Swordsman. Holds the line in front of you. Draws the monsters' attention, cleaves crowds and charges down whatever threatens you.

entries.name: Thief
entries.subject: Thief. Fights from the blind side. Steps through shadow behind whatever attacks you, poisons its blades and vanishes in smoke when cornered.

entries.name: Warden
entries.subject: Warden. A shield that died still standing. Takes the blows meant for you, wards you in a barrier and shakes the ground under packs.

entries.name: Gravity Pull
entries.subject: Gravity Pull. Instantly pull nearby enemies toward the selected center, then deal {damage_min}-{damage_max} Dark damage within {radius} m. Walls and knockback resistance limit the pull.

entries.name: Spike Tentacle
entries.subject: Spike Tentacle. Spikes erupt in a {length} m line, dealing {damage_min}-{damage_max} Dark damage and stunning for {stun_duration} s (maximum 1.6 s).

entries.name: Mana Siphon
entries.subject: Mana Siphon. Drain up to {drain} Mana from each enemy within {radius} m and recover only the Mana actually drained. Cannot drain through walls or from empty pools.

entries.name: Dark Arts
entries.subject: Dark Arts. Deal {damage_min}-{damage_max} Dark magic damage to the enemy nearest your aim and apply one random curse: Weakened, Armor Broken, Silenced, or Bloodcurse (35% less healing), for {duration} s.

entries.name: Royal Guard
entries.subject: Royal Guard. Holds the line with a shield. Charges through enemies, draws them away from allies, and plants a standard that steadies everyone near it.

entries.name: Dark General
entries.subject: Dark General. Turns the Knight's armor into a weapon. Wide Dark sweeps weaken enemies, a heavy advance breaks lines, and a zone of Dark pulses spends Valor for a stronger first strike.

entries.name: Grand Paladin
entries.subject: Grand Paladin. Fights with Light and protects the party. A heavy Light strike spends Valor, sanctified ground hurts enemies and heals allies, and an oath cleanses and shields everyone nearby.

entries.name: Tracker
entries.subject: Tracker. Marks one quarry for its own shots, lays a line of snares, and looses a fan of arrows that strikes each enemy once.

entries.name: Wildwarden
entries.subject: Wildwarden. Shapes the ground. Briar volleys leave slowing patches, a living thicket roots and wears down enemies, and a refuge shields allies against slows.

entries.name: Starstrider
entries.subject: Starstrider. Strikes from far away. A piercing star shot spends Focus, an evasive vault empowers the next shot, and a rain of starlit arrows covers a chosen area.

entries.name: Arcanist
entries.subject: Arcanist. Casts with precision. A piercing lance of Light and Dark, a runic circle that strengthens spells cast inside it, and a ward paid for with Mana.

entries.name: Archmage
entries.subject: Archmage. Combines the elements. A tempest cycles Fire, Water and Lightning, a convergence spends Arcane Charge on one great blast, and Spellweave repeats the next spell.

entries.name: Void Sovereign
entries.subject: Void Sovereign. Bends space. A gravity well pulls enemies together, a Dark lance pierces armor and resistance, and a telegraphed rift spends Arcane Charge on a heavy explosion.

entries.name: Nightstalker
entries.subject: Nightstalker. Moves through shadow. A lunge that builds Combo, a veil that hides and protects, and an execution finisher that hits marked enemies harder.

entries.name: Phantom Reaper
entries.subject: Phantom Reaper. Strikes and vanishes. Crosses behind enemies, reaps a wide arc with Combo, and leaves afterimages that strike again.

entries.name: Blood Sovereign
entries.subject: Blood Sovereign. Lives on what it takes. Rending cuts cause Bleeding, a pact trades Health for damage and lifesteal, and an eclipse finisher heals from the damage it deals.

entries.name: Royal Aegis
entries.subject: Royal Aegis. Each block adds a crest (up to 3; they fade 10 s after your last block). With 3 crests your next weapon attack is a Royal Retort: it deals 30% more damage and sends a shield wave 4 m ahead that deals 80% weapon damage and staggers.

entries.name: Conqueror's Dread
entries.subject: Conqueror's Dread. Defeating an enemy, or spending Valor on a skill, adds Dread (up to 5, 10 s): each Dread gives 2% more damage and 2% less damage taken.

entries.name: Dawnbringer
entries.subject: Dawnbringer. Every 5th weapon hit breaks the dawn around you (4 m): enemies take 60% weapon damage as Light, and you and your allies inside recover 2% of Maximum HP. At most once every 3 s.

entries.name: Hunter's Opening
entries.subject: Hunter's Opening. Your first arrow, bolt or javelin to strike an enemy at full health is a critical hit and deals 25% more damage.

entries.name: Rooted Stance
entries.subject: Rooted Stance. Stand still for 1 s in a fight and roots hold you: +10% Defense, +30% Knockback Resistance, and your arrows and bolts Slow what they hit for 2 s. Moving breaks the roots.

entries.name: Star Chart
entries.subject: Star Chart. Each arrow, bolt or javelin that strikes an enemy more than 10 m away adds a star (up to 5; they fade 12 s after the last). With 5 stars your next shot is a Shooting Star: 60% more damage, and it pierces every enemy in line (enemies after the first take 60%).

entries.name: Runescript
entries.subject: Runescript. Each spell you pay Mana for writes a rune (up to 3, 8 s): your spells deal 4% more damage for each rune.

entries.name: Elemental Attunement
entries.subject: Elemental Attunement. Every damaging spell you pay Mana for turns your attunement Fire > Ice > Lightning and sends an attuned bolt at the first enemy it strikes: 20% of that hit as the attuned element. The bolt cannot repeat, echo or trigger other effects.

entries.name: Collapse
entries.subject: Collapse. An enemy defeated by your spell collapses: enemies within 4 m are pulled up to 1.5 m toward it (walls stop the pull; bosses are not pulled) and take 30% of the defeating hit as Dark damage. At most once every 2 s.

entries.name: From the Shadows
entries.subject: From the Shadows. After a dodge, your next weapon attack within 2 s strikes from the shadows: 25% more damage and +1 Combo.

entries.name: Soul Harvest
entries.subject: Soul Harvest. Each enemy you defeat releases a soul: +1 Combo and Phantom Crossing recovers 2 s sooner. At most once a second.

entries.name: Blood Price
entries.subject: Blood Price. When an enemy dies while Bleeding, its blood bursts: enemies within 3 m start Bleeding at 40% of its bleed, and you recover 2% of Maximum HP. At most once a second.

entries.name: Aether Mend
entries.subject: Aether Mend. Mends you and every ally within 6 m: 18% of maximum HP at once and more over 4 s.

entries.name: Oathbound Mend
entries.subject: Oathbound Mend. Keeps its oath to you: heals 22% of your maximum HP at once and more over 4 s.

entries.name: The Last Rampart
entries.subject: The Last Rampart. Branthor plants himself like a wall: you and every Tempo near him are warded for 42% of maximum HP for 10 s, and every monster within 10 m turns on him.

entries.name: Rimecleave
entries.subject: Rimecleave. A frost-white arc that splits the air in front of Ysmera: 2.6 times weapon damage as Ice, and chill that freezes whole packs.

entries.name: Astral Lance
entries.subject: Astral Lance. A spear of starlight: 3.2 times spell damage as Light, and the target's healing and wards are burned away.

entries.name: Galestorm Volley
entries.subject: Galestorm Volley. Seven waves of arrows riding a gale: every monster under them is torn and thrown about.

entries.name: A Thousand Cuts
entries.subject: A Thousand Cuts. Mireth is behind a monster before it sees her: 2.8 times damage, far more below half health, and every kill readies the next cut.

entries.name: Gravewall
entries.subject: Gravewall. Thraxen brings a barrow's weight down around him: everything within 5.5 m is crushed and its armor broken.

entries.name: Thousand-Blade Dance
entries.subject: Thousand-Blade Dance. Caelith flickers from monster to monster, seven cuts in a breath, and every one bleeds.

entries.name: The Last Arrow
entries.subject: The Last Arrow. The arrow Wynter saved for the end: it passes through six monsters, freezing each one.

entries.name: Laughing Knives
entries.subject: Laughing Knives. A storm of thrown knives and a laugh no one forgets: every monster around Sable is cut and bleeds hard.

entries.name: Stormhymn
entries.subject: Stormhymn. Orrin sings and the sky answers: lightning leaps through eight monsters, shocking every one.

entries.name: The Mountain Walks
entries.subject: The Mountain Walks. Gorran strides and the ground breaks for 7 m around him: 2.8 times weapon damage as Earth, and no armor survives it.

entries.name: Sunsworn Judgment
entries.subject: Sunsworn Judgment. A blade of noon light swept in a wide ring: 3.4 times weapon damage as Light, doubled against the badly hurt.

entries.name: Tidecall
entries.subject: Tidecall. The moon-tide rises around Ilyra: you and every ally within 14 m are healed 45% of maximum HP, more over 4 s, and cleansed.

entries.name: Skyburner
entries.subject: Skyburner. Eight waves of arrows that fall like burning stars over a wide field.

entries.name: The Unseen Crown
entries.subject: The Unseen Crown. Veyl wears the dark like a crown: 3.6 times damage from behind, triple below half health, and every kill readies the next.

entries.name: Unfallen
entries.subject: Unfallen. Bramwold's heart never stopped: you and every Tempo near him are warded for half of maximum HP, and every monster within 12 m turns on him.

entries.name: Dawnbreakers' Oath
entries.subject: Dawnbreakers' Oath. Estrid carries the Dawnbreakers' fire: she dashes through eight monsters and sets every one of them burning.

entries.name: Comet Shot
entries.subject: Comet Shot. An arrow with a comet's tail: 4.2 times damage through eight monsters in a line.

entries.name: Whisper of Knives
entries.subject: Whisper of Knives. A hush, then knives from nowhere: every monster within 5 m is cut as Dark and cursed.

entries.name: Worldsong
entries.subject: Worldsong. Ethra sings the song the world was made with: a burst of light 7 m wide that unmakes wards and healing.

entries.name: Flame Etching
entries.subject: Flame Etching. A rune of cinders. Part of every hit burns, and Burning hurts more.

entries.name: Frost Etching
entries.subject: Frost Etching. A rune of rime. Part of every hit is ice, and Chill builds toward Freeze faster.

entries.name: Storm Etching
entries.subject: Storm Etching. A rune of thunder. Part of every hit is lightning, and the weapon moves quicker.

entries.name: Stone Etching
entries.subject: Stone Etching. A rune of the deep. Part of every hit is earth; armor gives way and poise breaks sooner.

entries.name: Radiant Etching
entries.subject: Radiant Etching. A rune of dawn. Part of every hit is light, and healing you give or receive is stronger.

entries.name: Umbral Etching
entries.subject: Umbral Etching. A rune of dusk. Part of every hit is shadow, and a share of the damage returns as life.

entries.name: Whetted Edge
entries.subject: Whetted Edge. Grind and re-hone: more Physical Damage.

entries.name: Balanced Grip
entries.subject: Balanced Grip. Rebalance the weight: swings come faster and find weak spots.

entries.name: Serrated Teeth
entries.subject: Serrated Teeth. Cut a row of teeth: critical hits hit harder and bleeding bites deeper.

entries.name: Weighted Head
entries.subject: Weighted Head. Cast in a heavy cap: bigger stagger and harder collisions.

entries.name: Piercing Point
entries.subject: Piercing Point. Narrow the tip: ignores part of the target's armor.

entries.name: Fine Sights
entries.subject: Fine Sights. Fit a sighting notch and true the shaft: straighter, faster, deadlier shots.
